summary.scope: All git-tracked and non-ignored untracked input files, excluding audit outputs and ignored dependency/build/private files
summary.method_limits: Complete byte/static coverage plus targeted semantic source review, not sentence-by-sentence verification or visual review of every file.

findings.title: Public machine-readable product descriptions still advertise the old five-world launch (P1)
The AI-plugin manifest declares a non-OpenAPI health endpoint as its API specification (P2)
The downloadable runtime lab is behind its source package and converter pins (P1)
The replaced hand-rolled TensorFlow mock remains as 463 dead lines in the runner (P2)
A retired dashboard world-grid and its tests have no runtime consumers (P2)
Old visual and journey CSS still ships without corresponding markup (P2)
Two progress lookup APIs have zero consumers (P3)
Capstone model documentation contradicts actual shipped model contracts (P1)
Several smaller unused declarations remain in otherwise active files (P3)
Browser-backend test-double drift was repaired during the audit (resolved observation)
Old browser audit harnesses require the retired six-step lesson flow
The learner README backfill still treats encrypted credentials as plaintext tokens
The public bridges package advertises entries its build cannot produce
Public bridge documentation claims frameworks the types reject
The daily digest's payment reconciliation compares different populations
Mounted legacy endpoints have no current in-repository consumers
Several production exports only serve tests or have no consumer
One-release rebrand compatibility shims survived multiple later releases
Current code comments describe behavior the code no longer has
The newsletter send wrapper defaults to an old API port
Art reference metadata labels JPEG bytes as PNG
Certificate secret documentation claims a verification behavior that does not exist
The writing gate skips every live exercise instruction body
A build transform still changes reading order for the retired two-column lesson layout
Three Neon exercise parent IDs still point to Deep Orbit lesson slugs after the Neon rename
The blog link gate validates source filenames and authored availability instead of actual routes
Three public content query helpers have no consumers
Current-code comments and test fixtures still describe superseded product state
Visual baseline accounting prevents a complete mint or enforcement
Test types have drifted outside the normal workspace typecheck
The production RLS probe treats broken checks as successful denial
The deployment-drift check does not check the web deployment it describes
The onboarding browser test passes for an HTTP 500 error page
Review-launcher tests are outside CI's test inventory
Operational documentation contradicts startup and rate-limit behavior
Living architecture/specification sections retain obsolete implementation contracts
The root roadmap still asks for completed CSS work
Retention email drafts still carry obsolete product claims
CI documentation still teaches the old mock and a command the hook does not run

documentation_cleanup.authorization: Owner requested deletion of documentation that no longer serves a purpose.
documentation_cleanup.input_inventory_status: The file-coverage ledger and original audit evidence describe the pre-cleanup snapshot. The records below account for subsequent removals.
documentation_cleanup.retention: Active plans, current research, canonical product/story/authoring contracts, unique release evidence, art-production inputs, and E2E baselines remain. Deferred requirements were checked against retained plans/backlog before removal.
documentation_cleanup.evidence_provenance: Each retained_identical_copy has the same complete-file SHA-256 as its deleted alias. The original path preserves the capture scenario/revision identity; dated verification reports remain unchanged as historical evidence.

deleted_files.reason: Initial development/session ledger and obsolete V0.5/V1 task list. Its own header delegates all post-launch/deferred work to the canonical backlog. ROADMAP.md already preserves the complete retained implementation inventory. Old status/counts, raw launch instructions, six-step schema, removed feature claims and remote personal-plan paths have no current execution role.

Unfinished May8 polish checklist for deleted inbox/operator-log/counterfactual/lore surfaces.
